children: Britain and Canada said on Sunday they will develop a framework for cooperation between their respective defence-funding initiatives, the Defence, Security and Resilience Bank and Multilateral Defence Mechanism.
The countries said they had agreed to establish two distinct but complementary institutions to support each other on investment opportunities and strategic challenges.
